blocks.Markets: one row per bettable side: model probability, break-even (price-implied), edge, recommendation from the game-day sheet
blocks.Histogram: integer score bins with member counts
blocks.Sensitivity: correlation of each perturbed input with the team's score across the members

spread.BET: model beats the line by >= 3 points, both teams >= 10 games, |spread| < 20; sized at P = 0.55

moneyline.BET: market-shrunk edge (w 0.35) >= 0.03; staked only on an underdog once both teams have 10 games, at 0.25x size

total.BET: lean >= 3 points (display only: --no-include-totals); staked only on the under plus overs at lean >= 5 in slow games and only when the pace forecast <= 68.9; sized at p = max(model, 0.55)
total.LEAN: none: a total is bet or passed

Sensitivity.definition: Pearson correlation across the perturbed-input members between the input and the team's sampled score
